Two composition bugs were caught by this unit and are worth knowing. Pairing it with qwen35_router_logits_f32_f32w read the bf16 row as f32 pairs and produced uncorrelated logits; the matching variant is qwen35_router_logits_bf16_f32w. Second, qwen35_router_select dispatches to a *_shared sibling that reads a shared-expert gate column at logits[token*logits_stride + num_experts], but it only sigmoids that column after selection - selection reads [0, num_experts) - so logits_stride=num_experts with the plain kernel is correct and needs no dummy column. The selection contract is deliberately not 'exact match against an f32 reference': the bf16 prescale can flip a decision inside its own rounding, so the test measures the logit-space perturbation and requires agreement wherever the k-th/(k+1)-th logit gap exceeds it, asserting separately that every disagreement is inside it.
